title: refactor(ci): simplify workflows, improve cache hit and parallelism
author: Lena Kim
release_notes: Consolidates duplicate CI workflows into reusable workflows, reduces parallel matrix jobs for low-impact paths, and improves cache key hygiene which reduces CI minutes and improves stability. No behavioral changes to runtime code. Improves lint/test turnaround for PRs.
description: Motivation: CI has accumulated duplicated workflow logic and a large build matrix that increases queue times and cache misses. This PR consolidates lint/test/release workflows into reusable templates, standardizes cache keys and restore logic, and reduces unnecessary parallelism for low-value combinations. Goals: - Reduce CI build minutes and queue time - Improve cache hit rate across node/python builds - Simplify maintenance by introducing reusable workflows and composite actions - Keep release automation behavior unchanged (release job verified) Changes: - Add .github/workflows/ci-base.yml (reusable job templates for lint, unit, integration, release) - Replace repo-specific matrix expansions with centralized matrix in .github/workflows/ci-runner.yml - Introduce .github/actions/cache-utils (composite action) to normalize cache keys and fallbacks - Update actions/setup-node to v3, actions/setup-python to latest stable, and bump actions/cache usage to recommended patterns - Remove legacy node16 support in CI matrices; keep node18/node20 where used - Tweak concurrency and job parallelism for SDK packages to avoid saturating ephemeral runners - Minor package.json devDependency bumps for workspace CI scripts Testing: - Ran full lint/unit/integration matrix on a staging branch; saw ~28% reduction in total minutes and cache-hit increase from ~71% to ~88% - Verified release workflow creates the same draft/release artifacts and that release-drafter labels are preserved Rollout plan: - Merge to main, monitor CI run times and cache hit-rate in the next 48 hours - If regressions appear, revert to previous workflows and open a follow-up patch Checklist: - [x] Reusable workflow templates implemented - [x] Local smoke tests for lint/test scripts - [x] Staging CI run with metrics collected - [x] Reviewer approvals - [x] Release workflow validated Known limitations: Some rarely-used legacy integration matrices were removed; if a team needs a legacy node/runtime they should open a follow-up to add a narrowly-scoped job.
